visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins with a character in a yellow hoodie sitting at a brown table against a solid light yellow background. He has a very grumpy expression, mouth downturned, and he shakes a red and white box labeled 'CEREALS' into a light blue bowl, but only a few small cereal rings fall out. (2) A girl with pink hair tied in buns and a white dress with a black '北' character appears. She stands with her arms crossed and a stern, judgmental look. She slides a glass of milk onto the table and forcefully pulls the nearly empty cereal bowl away from the yellow hooded character. (3) The girl proceeds to make pancakes through exaggerated, comical steps. She first grabs a white chicken with a red comb and squeezes it to make it lay an egg into a bowl. Then she pours white powder from a brown bag clearly labeled 'FLOUR' into the mix. (4) She brings a black and white cow into the frame and milks it directly into the mixing bowl. A glinting metal whisk appears in her hand, and she uses a handheld electric mixer to blend the ingredients at a very high speed, indicated by rapid circular motion blur. (5) She turns a knob on a grey gas stove, producing bright orange and yellow flames. She pours batter into a pan, making circular pancakes, and flips them into the air. The yellow character watches with a skeptical, angry face while leaning on his arms. (6) A stack of pancakes appears. She pours thick syrup from a brown bottle labeled 'MAPLE SYRUP'. She then plants a seed in a brown flower pot, waters it, and uses electric-blue lightning energy from her hands to make a strawberry plant grow instantly. (7) She performs karate-style chops in the air, causing sliced strawberries to fall onto the pancakes. Finally, she sprays white whipped cream from a blue can onto the top. The yellow character becomes happy, picks up his milk, and a red heart pops up above him.
